shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omadesign · 27 PRs opened
shipped.summary: A long Monday evening session closing the gap with the pro creative apps Omadesign replaces. The Layout, Motion, Develop, Effect and Type menus now run real commands, channels gained spot inks, calculations and Photoshop exchange, and the native compositor picked up conic and shape gradients. All are open for review; none merged in this window.
bullets: Real commands in the Layout, Motion Animation, Develop, Effect and Type menus, plus Find Font and grouping
Spot ink channels with a canvas overlay, channel Calculations, and saved alpha and spot channels exchanged with Photoshop files
Exact flip and rotate for saved channels and the selection, and layer masks filtered through the shared channel engine
Asset Export gains bleed, JPEG quality, PNG-8, WebP and GIF variants, row reordering, and drag-to-collect from Layers
Symbol library import and in-place symbol swaps, plus linked document graphic styles
Recolor reduction presets, Gray and Lab tagged documents, auto white balance, and one-step Auto light undo
Conic and shape gradients in the native float compositor
